pages.text: Buy, collect, sell and recycle pallets throughout Northern Ireland and Ireland. Ballynahinch base. New, reconditioned, perimeter, lightweight and ISPM15 heat-treated pallets advertised.

Established in 1997 by John and Caroline McKay as a family business. Facility outside Ballynahinch; customers include manufacturing, processing and distribution businesses. Offers pallet sales, refurbishment, waste disposal and haulage using own fleet.

Surplus, redundant and non-returnable pallets collected. Good quality and repairable pallets accepted. One-off or regular clearances. Standard UK 1200x1000mm, stamped and unstamped Euro 1200x800mm, 1200x1200mm and 1100x1100mm advertised.

New, used and reconditioned pallets. Repair, sort, grade, collection, purchase, rebuild and purpose-build services. ISPM15 heat-treated pallets with batch certificates advertised. Standard UK, Euro, square, CP, plastic, bespoke and cardboard pallets listed.
Pallet seating, L-shaped sofas, large tables, bar stools, single and double seats and furniture sets available by quotation. Made using heat-treated pallets. No verified current price list.
New and used wooden pallet collars available on request. 1200x1000mm and 1200x800mm heat-treated sizes advertised. Warehouse, factory and transit applications; also illustrated as garden beds.
Commercial transport, specialist deliveries, warehousing and distribution across Ireland and UK. Own fleet includes artics, rigid vehicles and curtainside trailers.
Spa Pallet Services Ltd, 41 Guiness Road, Ballynahinch BT24 8QN. Phone 028 9756 3990, mobile 07808 099 588, email info@webuyanypalletsni.co.uk. Company number NI037444.
